title: Why Leaves Change Color
short_teaser: As daylight shortens, trees reduce chlorophyll production, allowing other pigments to become more visible.
story: As daylight shortens, trees reduce chlorophyll production, allowing other pigments to become more visible. Weather and species influence the exact color and timing. A change may reveal what was present all along but hidden by a stronger signal. Curiosity loosens assumptions. A better question can reveal options that certainty would have hidden. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
